entities.name: Israel Gutiérrez
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: José Israel Gutiérrez Zermeño is a Mexican professional basketball player for the Astros de Jalisco of the CIBACOPA. He also represents the Mexican national team, where he participated at the 2014 FIBA Basketball World Cup. He played college basketball for the Borregos ITESM Hidalgo.
